gaps.explanation: 'beyond all expectations' = better than anyone predicted.
'from 1 January' = beginning on that date (also 'with effect from').

gaps.sentence: Everything was packed ready in ___ of the movers' arrival.
___ all appearances, the house had stood empty for years.
gaps.explanation: 'To all appearances' = as far as one can tell from looking.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is at ___ open to traffic after three years of works.
The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: The climbers were well ___ of schedule by midday.
He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.
